The point at which revenue finally covers the fixed costs, after which every further sale contributes instead of merely shrinking the hole.
An advantage competitors cannot copy because the law will not let them, whether that is a patent, an exclusive licence or a regulator's permission that is no longer being granted to anyone new.

The share of customers who come back the following month without being prompted to, tracked because it is the clearest single sign that a product is worth returning to rather than merely worth trying once.

The lag between putting the money in and seeing anything come back out, during which the numbers get worse before they get better and somebody senior has to keep the funding in place while they do. Most of the argument happens in that stretch.
